## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Stele-Inscription for the Sòng Central Tàiyǐ Palace*

by [呂惠卿](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%91%82%E6%83%A0%E5%8D%BF) (Lǚ Huìqīng, 1032–1111) — Northern-Sòng reformist statesman

Completing the triad with [KR5c0365](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0365) and [KR5c0366](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0366): the stele-inscription for the **Zhōng Tài yǐ gōng** 中太乙宮 (Central Tàiyǐ Palace). Dated 1074 (Xī níng 7). Its author Lǚ Huìqīng was one of Wáng Ān shí's senior associates in the Xī níng reforms. Preserved as **DZ 967** / CT 967 (*Dòngshén bù, Jì chuán lèi* 洞神部記傳類).

**Dating.** 1074. Dynasty: 北宋.
